deployments_detail.use: "IA First" strategy: Microsoft 365 Copilot deployed to entire workforce; GitHub Copilot for 800+ developers; Dynamics 365 Sales

Customer-facing bill/receipt management tool using AI and natural language processing, letting customers search receipts conversationally (e.g. 'show me last year's electricity bills'), get summaries, returns, alerts. Bankinter says it is the first in the sector to apply NLP AI to bill management. [not disclosed]

First real payment transaction initiated by an AI agent on behalf of a client, executed with Visa under Visa's 'Agentic Ready' agentic-commerce program (alongside BBVA, CaixaBank, Abanca). [Visa (Agentic Ready program)]

Strategic alliance with Google Cloud to build a scalable data/channel-management architecture and give data scientists new AI capabilities for product improvement, customer-relationship transformation and operational/commercial process optimization. Framed as strategic; concrete production scope not detailed. [Google Cloud]

Generative-AI-powered WhatsApp assistant, operating 24/7, providing public bank information to clients and non-clients (no access to private data, no banking operations). Bankinter positions it as the first such gen-AI WhatsApp assistant in Spanish banking. [not disclosed]

Microsoft 365 Copilot deployed to the entire central-services workforce (rolled out from Oct 2024, extended bank-wide Apr 2026) to speed information analysis, data extraction and daily administrative tasks across retail, corporate, consumer finance, legal/compliance, risk, data and CRM areas. The bank reports tens of thousands of daily Copilot interactions. [Microsoft (Microsoft 365 Copilot)]
deployments_detail.value: tens of thousands of daily Copilot interactions

deployments_detail.use: Dozens of employee-built specialized AI agents in production for internal tasks: corporate mailbox triage, virtual employee assistants, automatic document interpretation, report generation, and process orchestration. [Microsoft (Copilot / Copilot Studio agents)]

Proprietary internal enterprise-ChatGPT / GPT tool built on Microsoft Azure OpenAI in the bank's private Azure cloud, letting employees work with the bank's own data confidentially. Launched by the Digital Banking area as an internal productivity/experimentation tool. [Microsoft Azure OpenAI (GPT / ChatGPT enterprise)]
GitHub Copilot deployed to more than 800 specialized developers to assist software development, as part of the IA First strategy. [Microsoft / GitHub (GitHub Copilot)]
Copilot in Dynamics 365 Sales deployed to the commercial/sales network to support commercial teams' productivity. [Microsoft (Dynamics 365 Sales Copilot)]
